L6.note: §2 rule 1 local case on the swapped binary bf74d9e93. The claim under test is that a resolvable local image reference ARRIVES AS A PHOTO — not a 📎 document and not a bare path string. Measured: it does. msg 96143 is media.type=photo/image/jpeg and the send line's len=5180 is the fixture's exact byte count, so the bytes are provably the fixture and not a stray file. Mechanism note, recorded so this verdict is not read for more than it measures: on the TOOL plane (telegram_send → send.rs) the text ships as html and the image bytes ride the detached leg (rule 5's floor, which is un-gated by design); the rich media-array leg for local images is the TURN plane (delivery.rs), which the earlier truncated-fixture probe msg 96054 proved is attempted there too (it failed with 400 IMAGE_PROCESS_FAILED on the invalid PNG). The old L6 observation was withdrawn for a bad FIXTURE, not for a bad binary; with the fixture structurally validated (fixture-l6 PASS: 512x512, CRCs OK, ends on IEND, inflates to 1049088 = expected) the same reference now delivers a photo.
